snippet.title: The Royal Restoration Society - Multiplayer Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5187990/The_Royal_Restoration_Society/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=announcement

The Royal Restoration Society is a tidying up game where you clean and redecorate an entire castle room by room. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Play solo or invite up to 3 of your friends to help you restore the once-regal Castle Marmosa.

#indiegame #gaming #relaxing #cozy
